name: Telegram
description: Full Telegram MTProto user-client for vynkor — N-account, agent delegate. Read/write/search from personal and corporate accounts.
author: vynkor-core

actions.name: status
actions.description: Plugin status with version and account info

actions.name: tg_list_dialogs
actions.description: List dialogs with names/usernames + unread; query/limit/account/unread_only/fields(minimal/full or comma list like peer,name,unread_count), 10s cache

limit.description: Max items to return. Default 20, clamped to 1..100.

query.description: Filter dialogs by title/username substring. Aliases: q, search.

unread_only.description: Return only dialogs with unread messages. Alias: only_unread.

fields.description: Comma-separated field allowlist to trim the response payload.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_get_history
actions.description: Get message history from a peer

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

limit.description: Max items to return. Default 20, clamped to 1..100.

fields.description: Comma-separated field allowlist to trim the response payload.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_get_message
actions.description: Get a single message by peer and id

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages. Optional; defaults to 'self'.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_search
actions.description: Search messages across dialogs

query.description: Text to search for across all chats.

limit.description: Max items to return. Default 20, clamped to 1..100.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_send_message
actions.description: Send a text message to a peer

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

no_typing.description: Skip the typing indicator before sending. Alias: skip_typing.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_edit_message
actions.description: Edit a sent message

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

message_id.description: Id of the message to edit.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_delete_message
actions.description: Delete a message

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

message_id.description: Id of the message to delete. Use tg_delete_messages for several.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_delete_messages
actions.description: Delete multiple messages

actions.name: tg_forward_message
actions.description: Forward a message to another peer

from_peer.description: Source peer. Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

to_peer.description: Destination peer. Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

message_id.description: Id of the message to forward. Use tg_forward_messages for several.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_forward_messages
actions.description: Forward multiple messages to another peer

actions.name: tg_add_reaction
actions.description: Add a reaction to a message

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

message_id.description: Id of the message to react to. Alias: id.

reaction.description: Emoji to send, e.g. '❤️'. Alias: emoji.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_pin_message
actions.description: Pin a message in a chat

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

message_id.description: Id of the message to pin.

silent.description: Pin without notifying chat members. Default false.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_upload_media
actions.description: Upload a file as media to a peer

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload.

caption.description: Optional caption for the uploaded media.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_download_media
actions.description: Download media from a message

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

message_id.description: Id of the message holding the media. Alias: id.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the downloaded file to. Alias: path.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_send_voice
actions.description: Send a voice message

actions.name: tg_send_sticker
actions.description: Send a sticker

actions.name: tg_send_animation
actions.description: Send an animation (GIF)

actions.name: tg_get_chat_info
actions.description: Get chat info by peer — fields filter, 10s cache, returns name, username, peer_type, id, phone etc.

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

fields.description: Comma-separated field allowlist to trim the response payload.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_get_user
actions.description: Get user by peer — fields filter, 10s cache, returns full_name, first/last, username, phone

actions.name: tg_list_contacts
actions.description: List contacts (phonebook) — query/limit/account/fields, 10s cache, returns peer+name+phone+usernames

actions.name: tg_get_contact
actions.description: Get contact by peer — fields filter, 10s cache, returns name, usernames, phone, is_contact/mutual

actions.name: tg_list_unread
actions.description: List unread dialogs — limit/account/fields/include_messages(false by default)/message_limit, 10s cache

limit.description: Max items to return. Default 20, clamped to 1..100.

include_messages.description: Include the unread message bodies, not just counts.

message_limit.description: Max messages per dialog when include_messages is true.

fields.description: Comma-separated field allowlist to trim the response payload.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_get_unread
actions.description: Alias for tg_list_unread — get all unread messages across chats

actions.name: tg_mark_read
actions.description: Mark chat as read — peer required for one chat (max_id/message_id optional, 0=all), or without peer marks all unread dialogs

peer.description: Target peer: 'user:ID', 'group:ID', 'channel:ID', '@username' (the @ is required for non-contacts), or 'self' for Saved Messages.

max_id.description: Mark read up to this message id. Aliases: message_id, id. Default 0 = all.

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_mark_all_read
actions.description: Alias for tg_mark_read without peer — marks all unread dialogs as read

account.description: Account slug; defaults to the plugin's configured default account.

actions.name: tg_send_action
actions.description: Emulate typing/upload/record action in a chat — peer, action=typing/cancel/record_audio/record_video/upload_photo/etc., progress 0-100, duration_ms optional

actions.name: tg_set_typing
actions.description: Alias for tg_send_action — set typing indicator

actions.name: tg_transcribe_voice
actions.description: Download voice/media message to file for STT — peer, message_id, output_path? -> output_path, then call stt_transcribe
